_doc: Surface keyword map (SPEC_PET_DESIGN_AXES §3.2) — resolves a TYPED animal name to a surface when the catalog has no entry. Seeded per-WORD from the motion registry's keyword lists (avian.json, serpentine.json, quadruped.json) — never per movement class: winged_flyer (dragon=scales, bat=fur, butterfly=neither) and aquatic (fish=scales, dolphin=skin, octopus=neither) are mixed-surface classes, which is exactly why surface is not a motion field (§0.4). Borrow the vocabulary, not the classification. Matching is word-boundary, case-insensitive, longest keyword wins. NO fallback surface: a name matching nothing resolves to null → the design step shows only the universal axes (§3.3) — it never guesses fur onto a clockwork octopus. A keyword must appear under at most ONE surface (guard-tested). Typed animals that resolve to null are logged by the fill endpoint; that log is this file's growth list — each miss is a one-line edit here.
